note: Guards are hard: a candidate failing any of them has no score. Positive paired deltas are candidate minus baseline. v3, plan 018 (user decisions 18 Sep 2026): the objective is the attack on a static defence on generated town maps; symmetric town battles carry the paired behaviour guards; generated trench maps only prove soldiers still shoot. The selectors guard is relative to the lineage root (no selector the root passes may fail); parity is the lineage rule (controllers the node does not own stay digest-identical, static-defence battle included). v1 and v2 are preserved beside this file.

objective.note: Per battle: defenders put out of action (fraction of the 12) minus half the attacker's own loss fraction, against Ember soldiers who hold cover and never relocate. Mean per set with a cluster bootstrap on the map; ranked by the lower bound on town-attack-val. Cleared share and both loss fractions are reported, not optimised. Attack only: defence and a manoeuvring enemy are not measured (plan 018 limits).
